informal: The Lean proves \(\mathsf{L}=\mathsf{RL}\) and \(\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}\) by chaining the inclusions \(\mathsf{L}\subseteq\mathsf{RL}\subseteq\mathsf{BPL}\subseteq\mathsf{L}\).

results.note: The repository's formalization.yaml names exact_logarithmic_space_derandomization as the formalization of Theorem 1.1, and its proof uses exactly the three class inclusions listed here.

chunks.Equality.exact_logarithmic_space_derando: Antisymmetry with \(\mathsf{L}\subseteq\mathsf{RL}\) gives \(\mathsf{L}=\mathsf{RL}\), and antisymmetry with \(\mathsf{BPL}\subseteq\mathsf{L}\subseteq\mathsf{RL}\) gives \(\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}\).

chunks.Equality.BPL_subset_L/0: Take \(A\in\mathsf{BPL}\) with machine \(\mathcal M\), logarithmic space bound and polynomial clock \(T(n)\), fix the analytic constants, and pad the size parameter to \(B=\max(m,6)\) with \(m\) above the estimator's error budget.
chunks.Equality.BPL_subset_L/2: The error budget is at most \(2^{B}\).
chunks.Equality.BPL_subset_L/2/2: Since the budget is below \(m\le B\le 2^{B}\), it is at most \(2^{B}\).
chunks.Equality.BPL_subset_L/3: The source machine satisfies the logarithmic space bound.
chunks.Equality.BPL_subset_L/4: Take the deterministic estimator \(f\) with error at most \(1/32\) and reduce membership in \(\mathsf{L}\) to the acceptance gap of \(\mathcal M\).

chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/0: Given \(A\in\mathsf{RL}\) with machine \(\mathcal M\), use the machine that runs \(\mathcal M\) twice on independent coins and accepts if either run accepts, with clock exponent doubled.
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/1: The doubled machine uses at most \(2d\lceil\log_2(n+2)\rceil\) work cells.
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/1/0: Take the space constant \(d\) of \(\mathcal M\) and aim for the constant \(2d\).
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/1/1: Each run of \(\mathcal M\) uses at most \(d\lceil\log_2(n+2)\rceil\) cells.
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/1/2: The two runs together use at most \(2d\lceil\log_2(n+2)\rceil\) cells.
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/2: On every input the doubled machine halts within its clock and has acceptance probability \(\ge 2/3\) on \(A\) and \(\le 1/3\) off \(A\).
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/2/0: Fix \(x\) and the clock \(t=T(|x|)\) of \(\mathcal M\).
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/2/1: \(\mathcal M\) halts on \(x\) within \(t\) steps for every coin sequence.
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/2/2: The doubled clock is \(2t\) and the doubled machine accepts with probability \(1-(1-p_{\mathcal M}(x))^2\).
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/2/3: The doubled machine halts within \(2t\) steps on every coin sequence.
chunks.Amplification.RL_subset_BPL/2/4: If \(x\in A\) then \(p_{\mathcal M}(x)\ge 1/2\), so \(1-(1-p_{\mathcal M}(x))^2\ge 3/4\ge 2/3\).

unmapped.reason: The Lean only builds a deterministic estimator with fixed additive error \(1/32\); accuracy \(2^{-q}\) supplied as part of the input is not formalized.
